subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Ler e compreender, silenciosamente e, em seguida, em voz alta, com autonomia e fluência, textos curtos com nível de textualidade adequado.

components.description_pt: Ler textos breves silenciosamente com independência e fluência no nível apropriado
components.description_en: Read short texts silently with independence and fluency at an appropriate level
components.cc_component_description: Read grade-level stories independently with sufficient accuracy and fluency for comprehension

components.description_pt: Ler texto do nível em voz alta com precisão, ritmo e expressão apropriados
components.description_en: Read on-level text aloud with accuracy, appropriate rate, and expression
components.cc_component_description: Read on-level text aloud with accuracy, appropriate rate, and expression

components.description_pt: Demonstrar compreensão de textos breves lidos independentemente
components.description_en: Demonstrate comprehension of short texts read independently
components.cc_component_description: Demonstrate comprehension of emergent-reader texts through retelling or response

cc_matches.description: Read with sufficient accuracy and fluency to support comprehension.
By the end of the year, read and comprehend literature, including stories, dramas, and poetry, at the high end of the grades 2—3 text complexity band independently and proficiently.
Read emergent-reader texts with purpose and understanding.
